# Set-ZbxRole

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a user role.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxRole [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixRole>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Type <ZabbixRoleType>] [-Rules <ZabbixRoleRuleRequest>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A user role sets what its users may see and do: the user type, the frontend sections, the API methods and the actions they may run. The Set-ZbxRole cmdlet changes the user roles given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with role.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every user role the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed user roles back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a user role

```powershell
Set-ZbxRole -InputObject 'Read-only operators' -Name 'Read-only support'
```

Renames the user role Read-only operators to Read-only support.

### Example 2: Change a user role and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxRole -InputObject 'Read-only operators' -Name 'Read-only support' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the user role Read-only operators back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixRole>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixRoleType`: Bound to -Type (ByPropertyName). The role type values: USER_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixRoleRuleRequest`: Bound to -Rules (ByPropertyName). rules of a ZabbixRoleCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixRole`: Role class.
